entry.author: Te Hiringa Mahara
entry.summary:
Throughout November 2023, we collected feedback from people about their experiences accessing mental health and addiction services in Aotearoa.

Watch our focus group questions for this project in New Zealand Sign Language.

Find more information here: https://www.mhwc.govt.nz/news-and-resources/mental-health-or-addiction-service-access-form/
